chains.title: G allele increases TCF7L2 binding at the MYC-335 (8q24.21) WNT-responsive enhancer, raising MYC expression in colonic epithelium
chains.element: MYC-335 enhancer (rs6983267-containing WNT-responsive element, chr8:127.40 Mb)
chains.cell_type: Colonic crypt epithelial / colorectal tumour cells (HCT 116 as model)

links.claim: The risk (ref) G allele creates a better match to the TCF/LEF consensus and is bound more strongly by TCF7L2 than the T allele; TCF7L2 is chosen within the TCF/LEF specificity group because it is the dominant, highly expressed TCF/LEF member in colonic epithelium and colorectal lines such as HCT 116, and it is the member reported at this site by ChIP. No QBiC-SELEX evidence was supplied, so coverage is unverified.
The variant sits in an enhancer (MYC-335) that is WNT-responsive and loops to the MYC promoter ~335 kb away.
Stronger TCF7L2 occupancy on the G allele increases enhancer activity and MYC transcription, giving modest allele-specific MYC expression in heterozygotes.
The effect is restricted to cells with active WNT/beta-catenin signalling and an open chromatin state at MYC-335, i.e. intestinal crypt/colorectal cancer cells.
Modestly elevated MYC in crypt progenitors increases proliferation and adenoma initiation, raising colorectal cancer risk for G carriers.

predictions: Allele-specific TCF7L2 ChIP in heterozygous colorectal cells favours G
Deletion or CRISPRi of the MYC-335 element lowers MYC and reduces proliferation
Allele-specific MYC expression in heterozygous normal colonic mucosa, G>T
Enhancer reporter with G shows higher activity than T, and the difference is abolished by dominant-negative TCF or beta-catenin inhibition
falsified_if: No allelic difference in TCF7L2 occupancy or reporter activity
MYC-335 deletion leaves MYC expression unchanged in colonic cells
4C/Hi-C shows no contact between the element and the MYC promoter

chains.title: Null: no TF-mediated effect of rs6983267 itself
predictions: No allele-specific binding, reporter activity or expression difference attributable to this base
Fine-mapping or allele-swap editing at rs6983267 leaves MYC/CCAT2 unchanged while a linked variant in the same haplotype block carries the signal
falsified_if: Isogenic single-base edit of G to T in colonic cells changes MYC or CCAT2 expression
Reproducible allele-specific TF binding at this base in heterozygotes

chains.title: Same TCF7L2 allelic binding difference acts mainly through the lncRNA CCAT2 transcribed from the locus
chains.element: rs6983267-containing element that also serves as the CCAT2 lncRNA body/promoter region

links.claim: G allele is bound more strongly by TCF7L2 (chosen within the TCF/LEF group on expression and ChIP grounds in colon).
The variant lies within the transcribed CCAT2 lncRNA locus, so the allele is carried in the RNA itself as well as in the DNA element.
The G allele increases CCAT2 output and the G-form of the CCAT2 RNA feeds back on TCF7L2/WNT activity, indirectly raising MYC rather than MYC being the direct enhancer target.
Effect requires WNT-active colonic epithelium where CCAT2 is expressed.
Higher CCAT2 promotes WNT signalling, chromosomal instability and tumour growth, increasing colorectal cancer risk.

predictions: CCAT2 shows strong allele-specific expression favouring G
ASO or shRNA knockdown of CCAT2 lowers MYC and WNT target genes
Ectopic G-form CCAT2 RNA raises MYC independently of the DNA element
falsified_if: CCAT2 knockdown leaves MYC and proliferation unchanged
CCAT2 is not detectably expressed in the relevant colonic cells
Enhancer effect on MYC persists when CCAT2 transcription is blocked

chains.title: LEF1, not TCF7L2, is the TCF/LEF member mediating the allelic effect on MYC
chains.cell_type: Colorectal tumour cells with high LEF1 (WNT-high)

links.claim: The G allele matches the shared TCF/LEF specificity; within that group LEF1 is selected because it is strongly induced in WNT-high colorectal tumours and is the most transcriptionally activating member, whereas TCF7L2 can act as a repressor in some contexts.
LEF1 occupies the same MYC-335 WNT-responsive element with beta-catenin.
G-allele-biased LEF1 occupancy raises MYC transcription.
Dependence on LEF1 restricts the effect to LEF1-high tumour or progenitor cells; TCF7L2-only cells would show little allelic effect.
Increased MYC drives proliferation and colorectal tumorigenesis in G carriers.

predictions: LEF1 knockdown abolishes the allelic reporter/expression difference while TCF7L2 knockdown does not
Allele-specific ChIP for LEF1 shows G bias at least as strong as for TCF7L2
Allelic effect size correlates with LEF1 expression across colorectal lines
falsified_if: LEF1 is not expressed or not bound at the element in colonic cells
TCF7L2 depletion alone removes the allelic effect

chains.title: Allelic enhancer acts on POU5F1B / another 8q24 gene rather than MYC
chains.element: rs6983267 enhancer within the 8q24 gene desert

links.claim: G allele binds TCF7L2 (TCF/LEF group member chosen by colonic expression) more strongly.
The element loops preferentially to the nearby POU5F1B promoter rather than to MYC in some colorectal cells.
G allele raises POU5F1B expression.
Restricted to colorectal epithelium where POU5F1B is detectably transcribed.
POU5F1B supports proliferation/stemness, contributing to colorectal cancer risk.

predictions: 4C from the element shows dominant contact with POU5F1B
POU5F1B shows allele-specific expression; MYC does not
POU5F1B knockdown reduces growth while MYC is unaffected by element deletion
falsified_if: POU5F1B is not expressed in colonic cells
Element deletion changes MYC but not POU5F1B

matrix.test: Allele-specific TCF7L2 ChIP-qPCR in a rs6983267-heterozygous colorectal line

outcomes.outcome: Clear G bias in bound DNA
Weak or no TCF7L2 bias; LEF1 ChIP shows the bias

matrix.test: ASO/siRNA knockdown of CCAT2 in HCT 116, then RT-qPCR of MYC and WNT targets
CRISPR single-base allele swap (G to T) in an isogenic colorectal line; RNA-seq for MYC, CCAT2, POU5F1B
Individual knockdown of TCF7L2 versus LEF1 followed by allelic reporter assay
4C-seq or Capture-C from the rs6983267 element in colorectal cells
QBiC-SELEX detail lookup for TCF7L2 and LEF1 coverage and predicted allelic score

outcomes.outcome: TCF7L2 own model predicting higher G binding supports H1
LEF1 model with comparable score keeps H3 open
No significant predicted effect supports null

next_experiment: ASO knockdown of CCAT2 in HCT 116 followed by RT-qPCR of MYC and canonical WNT targets: if MYC falls, the locus acts through the CCAT2 lncRNA (H2); if MYC is unchanged, the enhancer acts directly on MYC (H1). This is the cheapest assay that distinguishes the two leading chains, which share the same TCF7L2 G-biased binding step.
